title: Change ledger entry
description: One structured record per change to a distributed item. Consumers compute their drift from these; git records what bytes moved, the ledger records what to do about it.

item.description: Manifest item name, or 'system' for repo-wide changes.

kind.description: Drives consumer CI severity: breaking and a11y fail, the rest warn.

affects.description: Precise surface touched, e.g. prop:variant, token:--ui-bg-emphasis, slot:icon.

manual.description: What a human or agent must do by hand.

design.description: Paper/Figma node URL this change implements.

supersedes.description: Entry ids this one replaces. History is immutable; corrections supersede.
